"Still in Love with You" is a country song by Brooks & Dunn, released on their 1993 album *Hard Workin' Man*. The song was written by Don Cook, Kix Brooks, and Ronnie Dunn.

The song is a heartfelt ballad about a man who is leaving his lover but remains deeply in love with her. The lyrics describe his taxi waiting outside as he wishes he could hold her one last time. He imagines escaping on a horse into the sunset or flying away with wings, but acknowledges that no matter what he does, he'd still wake up in love with her.

Key lyrics include:
- "My taxi cab is waiting / Wish I could hold you one last time"
- "If I had a horse, I'd ride off in the sunset / If I had wings, I'd fly off in the sky so blue / If I had the time, I'd spend my whole life dreaming / But I'd wake up, still in love with you"

The song features a key change in the final chorus, building to an emotional climax as the narrator accepts that his love will persist despite the separation.
